<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a template that breaks an aliphatic carboxylic acid (C‑O bond) and forms an amide (C‑N bond), matching the described forward reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
